title: Cocompletion of a homotopy-cocomplete cofibration category
statement:
Use quasicategories, mapping spaces, coherent functors and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. Let $\mathcal A$ be an ordinary category with an initial object $0$ and classes $C,W$ of arrows. Assume: $C$ and $W$ contain isomorphisms and are closed under composition; $W$ is retract closed and has two-out-of-three; every object is cofibrant, meaning $0\to X\in C$; every arrow factors as a member of $C$ followed by a member of $W$; pushouts of members of $C$ exist and belong to $C$, and pushouts of members of $C\cap W$ belong to $C\cap W$. Suppose all $\mathcal U$-small coproducts exist, and the coproduct of any $\mathcal U$-small family of members of $C$ (respectively $C\cap W$) belongs to $C$ (respectively $C\cap W$). These are the all-cofibrant ordinary homotopy-cocomplete cofibration-category hypotheses.

Let $q:N(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal A[W^{-1}]_\infty$ be a homotopy coherent localization, defined by its universal property on entire coherent functor categories, in a sufficiently large universe. Then $\mathcal A[W^{-1}]_\infty$ admits all $\mathcal U$-small coherent colimits. The functor $q$ carries $0$, $\mathcal U$-small coproduct cocones and pushout squares along members of $C$ to initial objects, coproduct cocones and pushout squares, respectively. If $\mathcal E$ is any infinity category admitting all $\mathcal U$-small colimits and $T:N(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal E$ inverts $W$ and preserves these initial objects, coproduct cocones and cofibration pushout squares, then its factorization $\overline T:\mathcal A[W^{-1}]_\infty\to\mathcal E$ preserves all $\mathcal U$-small coherent colimits. This assertion includes transformations: restriction identifies the full coherent functor category of colimit-preserving functors on the localization with the full subcategory of such homotopy-cocontinuous functors $T$.
